title: Ensure a minimum number of administrators are set for the organization
description: Project Collection Administrators can change any permission, bypass any policy and read any repository in the organization; organization owners are members automatically. Too few is a lockout risk; too many multiplies the accounts whose compromise ends the discussion. People are counted; build services and service principals in the group are listed but not counted.
remediation: Organization settings -> Permissions -> Project Collection Administrators -> Members: remove the people who no longer need organization-wide administration, keeping at least two so a lost account cannot lock the organization out. Prefer Project Administrators for project-level work. A Microsoft Entra group in the membership is expanded only as far as Azure DevOps knows it — members appear once they have signed in — so review it in Entra as well. Adjust the range with thresholds.minOrgAdmins and thresholds.maxOrgAdmins in azure-devops-bench's config.
fixSummary: Review members at Organization settings -> Permissions -> Project Collection Administrators.
